# Metey Engineering & Consultancy

> Metey Engineering & Consultancy Pvt Ltd: architecture and structural engineering consultants. Established 2013, registered in Hyderabad (combined Andhra Pradesh); head office in Hyderabad, branch office in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh. Designing durable, sustainable and fast-to-build structures across India since 2013 — from 30+ storey towers to precast mass housing.

- Head office: 2-4-216, Road 9A, Snehapuri Colony, New Nagole, Hyderabad 500035, Telangana
- Phone: +91 97001 59325, +91 40 2414 5925, +91 94947 56526
- Email: designs@metey.in, prasad@metey.in
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/meteyengineeringnconsultancy/

## Pages

- [Home](https://metey.in/): Designing durable, sustainable and fast-to-build structures across India since 2013 — from 30+ storey towers to precast mass housing.
- [About](https://metey.in/about/): Established in 2013, METEY's core strengths are architecture and structural engineering, with precast, monolithic and other modern construction technologies.
- [Services](https://metey.in/services/): Architecture, structural consultancy, MEP, interiors, peer review and value engineering, and project management consultancy for projects across India.
- [Technologies](https://metey.in/technologies/): Precast, monolithic (Mivan), composite, insulated wall (EPS), light gauge steel, Perma form, polymer wall and timber structures, designed by Metey across India.
- [Projects](https://metey.in/projects/): 42 projects in 11 states and Delhi: PMAY and EWS housing, precast and monolithic towers, education, commercial and industrial buildings.
- [Clients](https://metey.in/clients/): METEY clients include DRDO, GHMC, APTIDCO, APCPDCL, Tata Projects, NTPC, Jindal Steel & Power, Numaligarh Refinery and IIT Patna.
- [Team](https://metey.in/team/): Er. C.A. Prasad, Director & Chief Structural Engineer with 48 years of experience, and METEY's architects, structural engineers and quantity surveyors.
- [Insights](https://metey.in/insights/): Technical papers by METEY on precast concrete connections, monolithic EWS housing and green building technologies for PMAY, and talks at national conferences.
- [Careers](https://metey.in/careers/): Internships and careers for civil and structural engineers and architects at METEY, Hyderabad, mentored by chartered engineers on live projects.
- [Contact](https://metey.in/contact/): Contact Metey Engineering & Consultancy, New Nagole, Hyderabad: +91 97001 59325, designs@metey.in. Structural and architectural design across India.
